quarterly_data.signal: Foxconn MOPS filing (supplementing its 07-17-2026 announcement; on behalf of subsidiary Foxconn (Far East) Limited): sold 5,544,000 common shares of equity-method investee Zhen Ding Technology Holding between September 1 and October 12, 2026 to realise investment gains, with a disposal gain of NT$2,682,907,155. After the sales it holds 299,971,627 Zhen Ding shares, a 26.47% stake, with no restrictions such as pledges.
